title: FLA import: shapeBlend (distributive/angular) never decoded from binary; always defaults to distributive
description: The Frame model has shapeBlend: 'distributive' | 'angular' but flash8-binary.ts never decodes this field from CPicFrame. The binary likely stores a blend mode byte alongside the keyMode/ease fields. Without decoding it, all imported shape tweens use distributive blending regardless of the FLA's setting. Requires: (1) find the shapeBlend byte position in flash8-binary.ts CPicFrame reading, (2) decode and carry it through Fla8Frame, (3) forward in flash8-import.ts createFrame call, (4) also verify compile.ts passes shapeBlend to encodeDefineMorphShape2.
